scope.official_web: Search-index text only; direct Bohemia page opens returned HTTP 403. Reforger material is sibling-product evidence.

decisions.decision: Installed DayZ Workbench is the strongest baseline conversion hypothesis; its binary strings, extracted metadata, and pinned public source/output/meta triples corroborate it. Menu behavior, defaults, emitted bytes, and success remain unobserved.

Never infer or transplant a GUID. Reforger supports copied {GUID}path identities, but DayZ Copy Resource Name(s) and GUID necessity are unproven; pinned Dabs Framework uses a plain EDDS path. Define a plain-path fallback for the same single attempt.

Generic DDS samples did not reproduce the observed EDDS ENF1 and mip-table structure, so rename-only is not an evidence-backed recipe. Reject claims of native runtime rejection because none was tested, and inspect the table at 0x80 for legacy headers or 0x94 for DX10 headers.
Reopened ImageToPAA strings, BinMake rules, TexConvert configuration, and indexed official text establish PAA/PAC support, not an identified EDDS command.
The third-party writer remains a later candidate: inspected tests establish same-library parsing/round-trip behavior, not DayZ rendering, and the packer emits no Workbench metadata or allocated GUID.

unresolved: Whether .edds.meta is runtime-required; include generated metadata only as a baseline control.
Whether plain virtual EDDS paths render in DayZ; public implementations are corroboration, not this council's runtime proof.
Whether DayZ Workbench exposes Copy Resource Name(s), its defaults, and its generated identity/metadata behavior.
Workbench conversion and client rendering for the proposed original-art fixture.

blocking_prerequisites: Mount and record the exact project/source root exposing P:/EDDSProbe; P: is absent now. Hash the selected .gproj.
Replace generic-DDS rejection language with structural non-equivalence and unresolved runtime behavior; make the table offset header-dependent.
If DayZ offers an exact EDDS resource name, use it; otherwise use EDDSProbe/GUI/imagesets/probe_ui.edds as the predeclared plain-path hypothesis without inventing a GUID.

Provide one standalone EDDSProbe client PBO: exact prefix/source layout, CfgPatches/CfgMods/imageset registration, Game/World/Mission dependencies, justified requiredAddons, missionScriptModule path, MissionGameplay.OnInit hook after super, null guards, and unique create/load log tokens.

Set widget color 1 1 1 1 with blend and source alpha, render the half-alpha cyan fixture across known contrasting backgrounds, and retain lossless pixel evidence plus the opaque magenta control. Do not infer exact alpha from human inspection alone.
implementation_gate.stopping_condition: One default Workbench import and one baseline client run, with at most one rerun for an objectively identified packaging/reference defect. No generic-DDS, metadata, GUID, compression, or third-party variation before the baseline passes.
implementation_gate.after_repair: Evidence is sufficient to implement the bounded experiment, not to claim it passed.

project.note: Maps Workdrive P:/ but contains local StarDZ entries; P: and P:/EDDSProbe were absent.
